statement: Wii Balance Board page describes an 11-byte extension-data region at 0xA40000–0xA4000A: four big-endian 16-bit load-cell readings in order top-right, bottom-right, top-left and bottom-left; byte 8 temperature; byte 9 reserved zero; byte 10 battery reading. This is a specialized device protocol, not a standard Classic/Nunchuk six-byte attachment and is outside C5 scope.

applicability.revision: WiiBrew pinned community documentation; no authenticated retail capture
applicability.scope: Wii Balance Board > Extension Controller Documentation > Data Format. Source-only, not a physical acceptance result. Do not assign this shape to wii-c5-extension-packing or treat it as MotionPlus pass-through.
